title: How many reps should you do to build muscle?
hook: How many reps should you do to build muscle?
caption:
How many reps should you do to build muscle?

8–12 can work, but it isn’t a magic range. Research shows that muscle can grow across a broad range of reps when your sets are challenging enough.

The useful range depends on the exercise. A heavy squat, a machine press, and a lateral raise don’t all need to be trained the same way.

Pick a range you can control. Keep your effort consistent. For the lifts you track closely, build toward the top of that range before adding weight.

Swipe for the science, suggested rep ranges, and a simple way to progress. Save it for your next workout.

#MuscleGrow
